name: Merida Scultura Endurance 4000
why_interesting: An exact-model owner review supplies a useful older 11-speed endurance build, while current official pages document a materially different 12-speed generation and a mainland list reference.
missing: Map the public R7000 review to an exact model year and generation
Claimed complete weight and numeric geometry for the reviewed older generation
Current dealer stock and final mainland transaction price

observed_price.price_basis: official mainland suggested retail for SCULTURA ENDURANCE 4000 25

support_note: Purchase through the official dealer finder. Merida's policy requires first-owner designated-dealer purchase, warranty card and receipt, with service through the original dealer or a Merida store.
source_note: The official mainland page lists ¥14,800 suggested retail and a dealer route. The review describes the stock alloy wheels as heavy; this is owner context rather than a universal ride verdict. The current global page instead lists CF3 II, Shimano 105 R7100 12-speed, Expert SLIII wheels, Re-Fuse 32 mm tires and 35 mm clearance, so those newer facts are not assigned to the reviewed older build.
